about.intro_content: Prof. Li Zhang is a Professor of Medical Oncology and Chief of the Department of Clinical Research and Phase I Unit at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou. Over a career spanning more than 40 years at SYSUCC, he has become a world-recognised authority on lung cancer and nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC).
about.detailed_content: Prof. Zhang serves as a Senior Consultant for the Center for Drug Evaluation (CDE) under China's National Medical Products Administration (NMPA), and was a principal architect of the National Guidance for Industry on Clinical Trials for Cancer Drugs. He holds leadership roles across major oncology societies including ASCO, ESMO, IASLC, MASCC, CSCO and CACA, and has published more than 400 peer-reviewed papers in journals including the New England Journal of Medicine, The Lancet, JAMA, The BMJ, Nature Medicine and The Lancet Oncology. His research focuses on molecular-driven prognostic and therapeutic strategies for lung cancer and NPC.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Li Zhang

items.question: Does Prof. Li Zhang accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to lung cancer or nasopharyngeal carcinoma at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Zhang's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Zhang specialises in the medical oncology treatment of lung cancer and nasopharyngeal carcinoma, including chemotherapy, targeted therapy and immunotherapy.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Is Prof. Zhang involved in clinical trials for lung cancer?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Zhang has led or contributed to more than 30 national and international multicentre clinical trials in lung cancer and NPC, and directs SYSUCC's Phase I clinical trial unit.

items.question: Why is Prof. Zhang considered a leading authority in Chinese oncology?
items.answer: Beyond his clinical work, Prof. Zhang has shaped national cancer drug regulation as a Senior Consultant to China's Center for Drug Evaluation and as a principal architect of national clinical trial guidance for cancer drugs.
